title: The hole that would swallow Everest

post.title: The hole in the ocean that would swallow Everest 🌊
post.premise: The deepest hole in the ocean is deeper than Everest is tall, by a lot
post.bait: How deep did you think it was? 👇
post.description:
South-west of Guam the sea floor drops into Challenger Deep, the deepest known point on Earth. This map story pins it, counts the way down, and drops Mount Everest into the trench to show how much water would still be above its summit.
How deep did you think it was? Tell us below.
post.cover_emoji_why: stories carry no icon on the cover (title + place only)
